featureName.description: The feature name that can be used to get the {@link #sensor} data

sensor.description: Sensor that is the source of data for the data report.

latestValue.description: Latest value in the window {@link SensorDataReport#start} to {@link SensorDataReport#end}

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

variance.description:
Result of the calculation of the sensor data variance in a window given by #start and #end.
(See AggOp#VARIANCE)

start.description: Start date selected to calculate the sensor data report.

end.description: End date selected to calculate the sensor data report.

interval.description: {@link Interval} selected to calculate the sensor data report.

flatlineRatio.description:
Percentage of Flatline in a {@link Timeseries}.
Field calculated by a Standard deviation in a window. When the result is equial to zero indicates that there is a flatline.
Then it calculates the AVG of flatlines to get the percentate"
flatlineRatio is a value between 0 and 100

missingDataRatio.description:
Percentate of missing data in a {@link Timeseries}.
missingDataRatio is a value between 0 and 100

assetName.description: {@link ReliabilityAsset} name purely used for display purposes. Denotes the participating asset from a {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation} during the creation of this report.

userAdded.description:
Represents whether the {@link SensorDataReport} is user added.
It's `true`, if the current SensorDataReport was generated for a sensor not related via {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s to the current asset.
It's `false`, if the current SensorDataReport was generated for a sensor related via {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s to the current asset.

title: Sensor Data report has calculated values in a specific time window.
name: SensorDataReport
